Pregnancy Tracker 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Track your pregnancy journey with week-by-week updates and personalized milestones
- Log symptoms, mood, and physical changes in a private, cross-device journal
- Countdown to your due date and always know your current trimester and baby's development stage
- Manage and receive reminders for OB appointments and key dates
- All personal data remains local on your device for complete privacy
